svg.text: EXAMPLE HOST PILOT: IPC FLOW (the renderer owns no filesystem access — everything goes through the preload bridge)
out: file:open-dialog · file:get-recent · file:open-recent · file:clear-recent · file:close-project
in: file:recent-items (list refresh, annotated with `exists`) · file:open-item (routed item push, not consumed by this panel)
EXAMPLE HOST PILOT: AFTER OPENING — the panel does not render the result; the main process replaces the whole renderer
